notes.title: Out of Early Access! Pixel Game Maker MV 1.0.0 Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are proud to announce the release of the v1.0.0 of Pixel Game Maker MV!
We received a lot of constructive feedback during the Early Access, and it helped us to improve the software greatly.

In addition to our coming out of the Early Access period, we are also about to release a 30-day trial version of Pixel Game Maker MV! 

Also, don't forget about the upcoming [b]Pixel Game Maker MV Game Development Challenge![/b]
The contest will start on [b]October 3rd[/b], and the winner will have their submission released on the Nintendo Switch. Any combination of art style and genre are welcome!
For more info, please visit our Itch.io page from October 3rd.
Please give it a try! We are looking forward to seeing your projects!

October 3rd will also see a physical release of Pixel Game Maker MV in Japan, but Steam users shall not be forgotten! To celebrate the launch, Pixel Game Maker is [b]now 30% off![/b]

Finally, 1.0.0 is not the final update for Pixel Game Maker MV!
We spent our time in Early Access focused on building a stable platform, and we feel that we have finally achieved that goal.
Going forward, our focus will be on addressing user requests for quality of life and functional enhancements, such as UI refinements or the addition of functionality like a database system.
Please stay excited for these future updates as we continue onwards!

Thank you for your support of Pixel Game Maker MV!

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the End User License Agreement
[*]Added the Steel Sword Story (Demo) and La Mulana 2 sample projects
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Player)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects to be detected as being incorrectly in the air when on a Slope
[/list]

"How to switch to Branches"
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.

"How to switch to Default"
Please execute the following process to revert from other versions to the current release.
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select "None - don't participate in any Beta programs" and close Properties.

notes.title: How Pixel Game Maker MV Came To Be
notes.content:
Early Access for Pixel Game Maker MV is just over the horizon. Today, we'd like to share with everyone a message from the producers detailing just how the game came to be!

[b]The Birth of Pixel Game Maker MV[/b]
Steam is home to many hit titles created using the RPG Maker series, such as To The Moon, etc.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/206440/To_the_Moon/

However, when checking out trends among the various games sold on Steam, we saw that action games were really pulling in a lot of fans. We feel that this is thanks to the fact that, with Steam games available all over the world, language barrier doesn't tend to be an issue, and players from around the globe find it easy to enjoy action games.

This got us hoping that releasing Pixel Game Maker MV just might encourage players to create even more Maker series games, and so we jumped right into development.

[b]Main Features[/b]
While there certainly are a large number of settings and buttons, etc., we're doing our best to ensure that Pixel Game Maker MV is as easy to use as possible. The software allows for the import of new assets and materials, so importing the assets scheduled to be made available on the official website should help provide some great ideas for animation settings and more.

Additionally, we've included all-new features such as physics and co-op/multiplayer battle play, further increasing the possibilities for the types of games you can create.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Btd0_qTzZgQ

Once you get the hang of the software, you'll be able to create amazing games without any coding required, with virtually no limits but your own imagination. The sample games we've made available were created by a single graphic designer, so be sure to check out some of the things that are possible with Pixel Game Maker MV!

[b]Sample Games[/b]
